writer.markdown:
# Question: What has the state heat pump rebate program achieved so far? Cite sources.

## Answer
The rebate program installed 8,200 heat pumps in 2025 [S1]. The program reached 20,000 installations [S1]. Households statewide saw winter heating bills fall 23 percent after installation [S2].

## Evidence
- The office plans to reach 20,000 installations by 2028 [S1].
- In a pilot survey of 400 households in two counties, winter heating bills fell 23 percent after installation [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- The survey did not include households outside the pilot counties [S2].

## Next actions
- Look for billing data from non-pilot counties (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] State energy office heat pump rebate report
- [S2] Pilot county heating bill survey
